questions.explanation: The Central Bank regulates commercial banks to ensure financial stability and protect depositors. questions.stem: Which of the following best describes a cheque?

options.text: A written order to pay a specific amount
A type of loan from the bank

questions.explanation: A cheque is indeed a written order directing a bank to pay a specific amount to a designated person. Option b is incorrect as that describes a loan. Option c misrepresents the function of a cheque, and option d refers to a different banking document.

distractorRationale.b: This option describes a loan, which is not the definition of a cheque.
distractorRationale.c: A cheque is not an advertisement; it is a financial instrument.
distractorRationale.d: A deposit slip is used for depositing money, not for payment.
